audience: breweries and taprooms that run their taplist and pours in RaspberryPints

useCases.title: Check what is on tap right now
useCases.text: List the taps with the beer on each tap and the keg volume left. Open one tap to see its active keg session.

useCases.title: Review recent pours for one tap
useCases.text: List the recorded pours, newest first. Limit them to one tap, or to pours since a time, for an incremental sync.

useCases.title: Look up beers by style, ABV and IBU
useCases.text: List the beers on the menu with their style, ABV, IBU and SRM. Open one beer by its id or by your own external id.

useCases.title: Add a beer to the menu and put it on tap
useCases.text: Create a beer with its name, style, ABV, IBU, SRM and brewery name. Then tap it on a tap to start a keg session.

useCases.title: Swap the beer on a tap
useCases.text: Untap the tap first, because a tap with an active session returns an error. Then tap a different beer on the same tap.
